PATCH writes the override only to the representative. If the read still falls back to a member's override, a stale member override cannot be cleared from the UI. Not observed in this data.

critical_code_review_comments: PATCH now resolves the siblings by loading ALL evaluations of the patient and calling _resolver_orden on each. This is fine at the current scale, but it is O(n) per toggle for patients with many evals.
The bool updates run one update_one per eval in a loop; update_many with {evaluacion_id: {$in: ids}} cannot upsert, so the loop is acceptable, but it is not atomic across the group.
